about:
The ideal venue for a dreamy palatial destination wedding. Suryagarh Jaisalmer sits on a threshold looking east towards the ancient city of Jaisalmer and west towards the Thar Desert whose rugged natural beauty provides venues and backdrops straight out of a royal fairy tale. The property itself is a magnificent fortress with a plethora of stately gardens and courtyards that leave you spoiled for choice while planning a dreamy palatial destination wedding. 

Space Available at Suryagarh Jaisalmer
The venue offers luxurious accommodation options for you and your guests, with well-appointed rooms and suites that are designed to provide a royal experience. The property also has a spa and wellness center for relaxation and rejuvenation. Yoga Garden and Khuzamsha Hall are both elegant indoor spaces that can accommodate up to 100-150 guests each. Both halls offer a beautiful ambiance that can be customized to suit your wedding style and preferences. With ample space and natural lighting, our indoor halls are perfect for an intimate wedding ceremony, reception or both. The Sunset Patio is a beautiful outdoor space that can accommodate up to 300-400 guests. The space is surrounded by lush greenery and offers a breathtaking view of the sunset, making it a romantic spot for your wedding ceremony or reception. If you're looking for a larger space, the Lakeside area by the pool is an ideal choice for a wedding. This space can accommodate up to 400-600 guests and offers a beautiful view of the pool and lake, creating a picturesque backdrop for your special day. With ample space and beautiful surroundings, this outdoor space is perfect for hosting your wedding ceremony and reception.

Services Offered by Suryagarh Jaisalmer
The experienced event planning team at Suryagarh Jaisalmer will work with you to meticulously plan and execute every aspect of your wedding, from venue selection to decor, entertainment, and more. They will ensure that your vision for your dream wedding comes to life. The culinary team will curate a customized menu for your wedding events, offering a delectable range of local and international cuisines. From halwai breakfasts to jazz brunches, and from Silk Route-themed sangeet dinners to indulgent after-parties, the food and beverage options at Suryagarh Jaisalmer will leave your guests craving for more. They can also arrange mesmerizing entertainers to add a touch of magic to your wedding celebrations.

Location
Suryagarh Jaisalmer is located in Kahala Phata, Sam Road, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan. It is 7 km from the abandoned village of Kuldhara, and 15 km from the Bara Bagh temple.

about:
The Marugarh Resort & Spa is an outdoor wedding venue located in beautiful city of Jodhpur, India. It is a paradise offering luxurious amenities, stunning landscapes and breathtaking views. The Resort offers an exquisite venue for wedding celebrations amidst ancient architecture, gardens and a tranquil pool. With stunning areas for the ceremony, reception, and wedding photo shoots, it is both romantic and elegant. The Resort also features a range of dining options and a signature restaurant. A team of knowledgeable and experienced staff are available to take care of every detail according to your requirements, to ensure every aspect is covered. They also boast a range of luxurious, air-conditioned suites and rooms for the perfect honeymoon or staycation. Onsite, you will also find an outdoor pool, spa, fitness centre and gorgeous gardens, guaranteed to provide the perfect backdrop for your wedding photos. The Marugarh Resort & Spa looks forward to making your special day truly dazzling, and will ensure your experience is nothing short of extraordinary.

Space available at The Marugarh Resort & Spa
The resort offers a stunning and spacious lawn area that can accommodate a large gathering of 2000 to 3000 people, making it an ideal location for hosting grand wedding celebrations. The lawn at the Marugarh Resort & Spa is an open-air space that provides a breathtaking view of the ancient architecture and stunning landscapes. The ambiance of the lawn is both romantic and elegant, perfect for a dream wedding. The lawn is beautifully decorated with fresh flowers, lighting, and other decorations, making it look magical.

The spacious lawn at the Marugarh Resort & Spa is designed to cater to various wedding functions such as engagement ceremonies, sangeet, mehndi, wedding ceremony, and reception. The area can be customized to suit the preferences of the bride and groom, and the professional and experienced team at the resort will ensure that every detail is covered.
